headline: IBM Shares Fall 5% on Software Growth Uncertainty
summary: Shares of IBM dropped 5% after Wall Street analysts raised concerns regarding the pace of future software division growth.
why: International Business Machines Corp. is a major US enterprise technology provider, with its hybrid cloud and software units key drivers of recurring revenue.

impacts.name: International Business Machines Corp.
impacts.why: Analysts flagged downside risks and uncertainty around enterprise software segment growth.

why_moved: IBM shares fell 5% following negative analyst commentary questioning software revenue performance.
